reason: A DeepSeek Harness integration that connects to OOMOL or OpenConnector through MCP to discover and execute actions in connected external services.

summaries.zh: 通过 MCP 将 DeepSeek Harness 连接到 OOMOL 或 OpenConnector，以发现并执行已连接外部服务中的操作。
summaries.en: Connects DeepSeek Harness to OOMOL or OpenConnector through MCP to discover and execute actions in connected external services.

capabilities: Connects to OOMOL Hosted or self-hosted OpenConnector endpoints over HTTP(S)
Discovers available connector actions progressively through MCP
Executes connector actions that may affect external accounts or services
Uses configured connector API keys or runtime tokens for authentication
